added.title: Director/VP of Engineering
added.description:
Director of Engineering | Autonomous Systems & Real-Time Software

Tempe / Phoenix, Arizona | ~$225k Base + Significant Equity

What if your next engineering leadership role gave you the opportunity to define the architecture, build the product, hire the team and put your fingerprints on an entirely new technology platform?
We're partnering exclusively with an early-stage technology company building at the intersection of drones, autonomous systems, AI and physical security
.

They're looking for their first senior software engineering leader
.

This is not a role for someone who wants to inherit a mature organization, manage from a distance or spend their days exclusively in meetings.

They need a genuine player-coach
.

You'll operate with Principal-level technical ownership while building the engineering organization around you. Initially, that means architecting systems, writing and reviewing code, shipping critical features and solving production problems yourself. As the company scales, you'll recruit and develop the engineers who increasingly take ownership alongside you.

What You'll Build

At the center of the opportunity is a real-time operational platform that enables security professionals to remotely monitor, pilot and ultimately automate physical systems across complex environments.

You'll have the freedom to shape the platform end-to-end across:
Real-time, operator-facing interfaces
Drone control and remote operations
Live data and video
Cloud infrastructure
APIs and external integrations
Reliability, security and observability
Connected physical systems
AI-assisted and increasingly autonomous capabilities

One of your earliest challenges will be helping overhaul the existing product and enabling operators to pilot drones directly through the platform
.

There is no predetermined technology playbook you're being hired to follow.

You'll determine what should be retained, what should be rebuilt, how the architecture should evolve and which engineers need to be hired next.

Who We're Looking For

You may come from autonomy, robotics, drones, aerospace, gaming, simulation, geospatial technology, public safety, physical security or another environment where sophisticated software interacts with the real world
.

Direct defense or drone experience is not required.

What matters more is that you've personally built and shipped complex software, understand real-time systems and production reliability, can architect across the full stack, and still genuinely enjoy being close to the technology.

You should also have experience hiring, mentoring or leading engineers
. The ambition isn't to remain a team of one. It's to build an exceptional engineering organization around the platform you help create.

Experience using modern AI coding tools and software agents
as part of serious production engineering would be particularly relevant.

Why This Opportunity?

Because genuine greenfield engineering leadership roles are rare.

You'll work directly alongside product leadership, operators and customers. You'll see how your software performs in real operational environments and have the authority to improve it.

You'll help decide the architecture.
You'll build critical parts of the product.
You'll hire the team.
You'll establish the engineering culture.
And you'll have meaningful equity in what you're helping create.

Most importantly, the mission has tangible human consequences: using technology to protect people, extend the capabilities of security professionals and reduce the need to put humans in harm's way.

The company is establishing its engineering organization in Tempe/Phoenix
. There is some flexibility during the initial build-out, but this is ultimately an onsite opportunity for someone who wants to build closely alongside the team.

Compensation:
Approximately $225k base, with flexibility for exceptional candidates, plus a significant equity component.

If you're an engineering leader who still considers yourself a builder and the idea of creating something from the ground up is more exciting than inheriting something already finished, I'd welcome a confidential conversation.

Please share your updated resume and upcoming availability.

About Invesco

As one of the world’s leading independent global investment firms, Invesco is dedicated to rethinking possibilities for our clients. By delivering the combined power of our distinctive investment management capabilities, we provide a wide range of investment strategies and vehicles to our clients around the world. Job Description

Director, Private Markets Technology (Private Credit & Global Real Estate)

Your Team

The Private Markets Technology team partners with Invesco’s Private Markets business to deliver scalable, resilient, and innovative solutions across private credit and global real estate. Invesco’s private markets platform spans private credit and real estate strategies that provide differentiated sources of income and growth for clients, supported by decades of experience and global scale. Within real estate, the firm delivers institutional investment capabilities and data-driven insights across diverse portfolios and asset types. The technology organization enables these investment strategies through modern platforms, cloud adoption, and data platforms such as Snowflake, ensuring transparency, scalability, and regulatory compliance.

Your Role

As Director, Private Markets Technology, you will lead the technology domain supporting Private Credit and Global Real Estate, owning delivery execution, architecture, and data strategy across these asset classes. You will lead through subordinate managers and senior engineers while partnering closely with investment, product, and operations leaders. This role requires deep expertise in private markets technology, including credit platforms such as Allvue Everest, real estate technology ecosystems, and modern cloud and data architectures. You will drive modernization through cloud, Snowflake-based data platforms, and AI-driven capabilities while ensuring strong operational performance and risk management across a complex, regulated environment.

You Will Be Responsible For:

Leading the end-to-end technology strategy and execution for Private Credit and Global Real Estate platforms
Managing and developing subordinate leaders and teams delivering critical front-to-back investment technology solutions
Owning core private credit platforms, including Allvue Everest, supporting portfolio management, credit analysis, and trade workflows across the investment lifecycle
Driving the architecture and integration of real estate technology platforms (e.g., Yardi, MRI, or equivalent systems) supporting complex real estate investment operations and reporting
Defining and executing a modern data strategy leveraging Snowflake or similar cloud data platforms to unify investment, portfolio, and operational data across private markets
Enabling advanced analytics, reporting, and AI use cases by building scalable, governed data pipelines and architectures
Translating business strategy into scalable technology and data roadmaps aligned to private markets growth
Delivering complex initiatives across cloud, data, and AI-enabled solutions to improve investment insights and operational efficiency
Ensuring solutions meet regulatory, risk, and data governance requirements across private credit and real estate operations
Leading vendor strategy and optimization across third-party platforms, including credit and real estate systems

The Experience You Bring:

Extensive experience leading technology organizations in financial services, with strong exposure to private markets (private credit, real estate, or alternatives)
Deep expertise with private credit platforms such as Allvue Everest or similar systems supporting front-to-back credit workflows
Strong knowledge of global real estate technology platforms (e.g., Yardi, MRI, RealPage, or equivalent PropTech ecosystems)
Proven experience designing and implementing cloud-based data platforms, including Snowflake, for large-scale investment or financial data environments
Experience building and governing enterprise data models, data pipelines, and analytics solutions supporting investment decision-making
Proven ability to lead managers and senior engineers in a complex, global organization
Strong cloud engineering and architecture experience, including modernization of legacy platforms
Experience applying AI, automation, or advanced analytics to improve investment processes and operational efficiency
Strong commercial acumen, including vendor management, budgeting, and operational performance accountability
Ability to influence senior executives and operate effectively in a highly matrixed organization

The salary range for this position in New York City is $240,000 - $260,000 year. The total compensation offered for this position includes salary and incentive pay and will vary based on skills, experience and location.

Full Time / Part Time

Full time

Worker Type

Employee

Job Exempt (Yes / No)

Yes

Workplace Model

Pursuant to Invesco’s Workplace Policy, employees are expected to comply with the firm’s most current workplace model, which as of October 1, 2025, includes spending at least four full days each week working in an Invesco office. This reflects our belief that spending time together in the office helps us build stronger relationships, collaborate more easily, and support each other’s growth and development.

Architecture & Design Leadership: Play a lead role in the design, architecture and implementation of trading, sales, and operations workflows, ensuring alignment with business goals and engineering best practices.

Mentorship & Technical Leadership: Mentor and coach junior and mid-level engineers, fostering a culture of continuous learning, technical growth, and engineering craftsmanship.

To be successful in this role, we’re seeking the following:

Bachelor’s degree in computer science or a related discipline, or equivalent work experience required, advanced degree preferred.
Industry Experience: 14 plus years of experience designing, building, and delivering real-time, scalable, and resilient software applications within Financial Services or similarly complex, high-throughput domains.
Core Backend Proficiency: Deep expertise in Java and the Spring ecosystem — including Spring Framework, Spring Boot, Spring Security, Spring Data, and ORM frameworks — with a strong focus on building production-grade, enterprise-scale services.
Frontend Development: Proficiency in modern front-end technologies including Angular, TypeScript/JavaScript, HTML/CSS, with working knowledge of jQuery and component-based UI architecture.

Messaging & Middleware: Hands-on experience with messaging and middleware technologies such as Apache Kafka, IBM MQ, FIX protocol, with an understanding of event-driven and asynchronous system design.
Agile Delivery: Solid understanding of Scrum and Agile methodologies, with a proven ability to deliver in fast-paced, rapidly evolving environments with shifting priorities.
Communication & Leadership: Excellent written and verbal communication skills; able to clearly articulate technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Strong organizational skills to coordinate, influence, and drive cross-team initiatives.
Problem Solving & Innovation: Demonstrated ability to analyze complex, ambiguous problems and devise pragmatic, innovative solutions — balancing technical rigor with delivery speed.
AI-Augmented Development: Familiarity with one or more AI coding and productivity tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Windsurf, Claude Code), with a willingness to leverage AI-assisted workflows to accelerate development and improve code quality.
(Note: We value T-shaped engineers — deep expertise in one discipline (backend or frontend) with broad familiarity across the stack is preferred over equal but shallow coverage of both)

added.description:
Overview

This is a remote role that may only be hired in the following location(s): Arizona, North Carolina and Texas.

The Senior IT Manager - Infrastructure Platforms is responsible for leading the administration, support, and operational stability of the bank's core infrastructure platforms, including Windows Server, Linux, AIX, enterprise storage, and backup services. This role provides hands-on leadership for a team of infrastructure professionals and ensures that critical systems are secure, highly available, recoverable, and aligned with business, regulatory, and operational requirements.

This position works closely with Information Security, Architecture, Application Support, Network Engineering, Risk, Audit, and business stakeholders to deliver resilient infrastructure services that support First Citizens Bank applications and enterprise operations. The ideal candidate combines strong technical depth with people leadership, operational discipline, and experience in regulated environments.

Responsibilities & Qualifications

Duties and Responsibilities:

Lead and manage the day-to-day operations of infrastructure teams supporting Windows, Linux, AIX, storage, and backup environments across production, disaster recovery, test, and development platforms.
Supervise, coach, and develop system administrators and engineers, including workload management, performance feedback, career development, and team planning.
Ensure high availability and reliability of infrastructure services through proactive monitoring, capacity planning, incident management, root cause analysis, and continuous service improvement.
Oversee lifecycle management for servers, operating systems, storage platforms, and backup systems, including installation, configuration, patching, upgrades, decommissioning, and hardware/software currency.
Maintain operational readiness for backup, restore, replication, and disaster recovery capabilities, ensuring recovery objectives are documented, tested, and achievable.
Partner with cybersecurity and risk teams to implement secure configuration standards, vulnerability remediation, privileged access controls, endpoint hardening, and compliance with internal policies and regulatory expectations.
Establish and enforce infrastructure standards for system builds, operational procedures, documentation, change controls, and platform governance.
Coordinate major incident response for supported platforms, providing leadership during outages, service degradation, and recovery events.
Support audits and examinations by preparing evidence, responding to control inquiries, and remediating identified gaps in a timely manner.
Manage vendor relationships for infrastructure hardware, software, maintenance, and support services, including issue escalation and service review.
Contribute to strategic planning for infrastructure modernization, automation, cloud integration where applicable, data center operations, and platform roadmap development.
Collaborate with application and database teams to support system performance, platform tuning, middleware dependencies, and infrastructure requirements for business initiatives.
Drive automation and operational efficiency through scripting, configuration management, standardized deployment processes, and reduction of manual support tasks.
Own capacity and performance management for compute, storage, and backup environments, ensuring sufficient scalability to meet growth and resilience needs.
Ensure adherence to ITIL-aligned processes for incident, problem, change, request, and configuration management.

Position Specific Skills

Previous leadership for technical implementation

Knowledge of Standard Development Life Cycles (like Waterfall or Agile)

Knowledge of system and data design

Qualifications

Minimum Required Education and Experience: Bachelor's Degree and 8 years' experience OR High School Diploma or GED/Equivalent and 12 years' experience in Applications development, analysis or engineering

Preferred Qualifications

7+ years of progressive IT infrastructure experience, including administration or engineering responsibilities across multiple enterprise server platforms.
3+ years of leadership or management experience, including direct supervision of technical staff, team coordination, or technical lead responsibility in a complex environment.
Demonstrated experience supporting Windows Server, Linux, AIX, enterprise storage, and backup platforms in a mid-sized or large enterprise environment.
Strong understanding of infrastructure operations, platform hardening, backup/recovery processes, disaster recovery, and production support.
Experience with change management, incident response, root cause analysis, and operational documentation.
Ability to communicate effectively with technical teams, senior leadership, auditors, vendors, and business stakeholders.
Experience working in a regulated environment with strong operational controls, documentation standards, and risk management expectations.

Preferred Areas Of Experience

Experience in the banking, financial services, or other highly regulated industries.
Experience supporting core banking platforms, payment systems, loan systems, treasury applications, or other business-critical financial workloads.
Familiarity with regulatory and control frameworks relevant to financial institutions, such as FFIEC guidance, SOX, PCI DSS, GLBA, or internal audit standards.
Experience with enterprise backup and recovery tools, storage area networks, replication technologies, and data retention controls.
Experience managing AIX on IBM Power Systems in support of critical applications.
Experience with virtualization platforms such as VMware or Hyper-V.
Exposure to infrastructure automation using PowerShell, Python, Ansible, or similar tools.
Experience with monitoring and observability platforms for infrastructure health, alerting, and performance analytics.
Familiarity with Active Directory, LDAP, DNS, DHCP, file services, and identity-integrated infrastructure services.
Experience participating in or leading disaster recovery exercises, cyber recovery planning, and resilience testing.
Knowledge of hybrid cloud connectivity and infrastructure integration strategies where applicable.

Skills

Infrastructure leadership with the ability to balance hands-on technical depth and managerial accountability.
Strong knowledge of Windows Server administration, including patching, security, troubleshooting, and operational support.
Strong knowledge of Linux administration across enterprise distributions, including performance tuning, scripting, patching, and security management.
Working knowledge of AIX administration, system support, and operational best practices.
Solid understanding of enterprise storage concepts, including SAN/NAS, provisioning, performance, replication, and capacity management.
Solid understanding of backup and recovery operations, including backup scheduling, retention, restore validation, and disaster recovery alignment.
Knowledge of system hardening, vulnerability remediation, and infrastructure security controls.
Strong skills in incident management, problem management, and root cause analysis.
Ability to create and maintain clear technical documentation, standards, runbooks, and procedures.
Effective people management, mentoring, and team development skills.
Strong organizational, prioritization, and decision-making abilities in fast-paced operational environments.
Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to translate technical issues for non-technical audiences.
Ability to work collaboratively across infrastructure, security, application, audit, and business teams.

Reporting Structure

The role will report into the Sr. Director Infrastructure and Operations and will have direct responsibility for system administrators, infrastructure engineers, or platform specialists.

Work Environment

This role may require participation in an on-call rotation, after-hours maintenance activities, disaster recovery testing, and incident response for critical production systems.

added.description:
We’re currently seeking a design leader to head our Small Business Bank Design team, which is part of the Experience Design organization.

Small Business Bank has been rated #1 in the J.D. Power U.S. Small Business Banking Satisfaction Study for 3 consecutive years. Our team delivers banking solutions and experiences that help small businesses run their business with confidence. We are a mission-driven team, spending our time with business owners and operators, understanding their needs, co-creating with them and celebrating their success as our success.

The Experience Design team at Capital One is at the forefront of enriching our customers’ digital and physical experiences and we are passionate about creating memorable, meaningful product experiences that build the Capital One brand with humanity and drive business advantage and innovation. We champion a thriving environment of collaboration, authenticity and healthy critique, in which we honor diversity of thought, create a culture of belonging, and elevate one another. If you’re a creative innovator who embraces an environment where you can experiment, learn, and change banking for good, we’d love to hear from you.

Role Expectations

As head of small business bank design, you’ll lead a talented, cross-disciplinary team of design leaders and designers, collaborate deeply with our research teams and Product and Technology leadership. You’ll be responsible for identifying and advocating for high-leverage opportunities with executive stakeholders and leading high-impact, highly complex design projects that set the bar for and drive experience excellence and business outcomes.

You will envision, design, deliver and optimize experiences across channels (including web, mobile, sales and servicing) and emerging technologies to help small and medium sized business customers run their business with confidence. This will include products and experiences such as:

Discovering banking products and opening an account online
Onboarding a small business and their employees with Capital One
Managing and moving money across different payment rails
Managing user permissions and preferences
Helping internal associate teams best service customers

As part of the business experiences design leadership team, you will help inform B2B experiences across Capital One. This includes:

Activating insights, features and capabilities that can extend across different kinds of business customers and segments
Connecting features and capabilities for customers who have a consumer and small business relationship with Capital One

Here are some of the expected competencies for this role:

Product Design Expertise: Leverage established expertise and leadership in product design to elevate the quality and maturity of the design practice at Capital One. Leveraging a variety of skills across interaction, visual and service design; in collaboration with cross-functional partners, help to oversee and optimize the use of appropriate tools, platforms, frameworks and design systems and enable your team to develop artifacts that may include vision stories, journey maps, blueprints, high-fidelity designs and prototypes
Leadership: Build a thriving community of designers who are well supported, trained for excellence and able to collaborate with peers in multiple functions and set the vision and strategic direction for your team in close partnership with your cross-functional partners
Human-Centered: Recognize and pursue opportunities where customer needs and business goals coincide, while reinforcing with teammates and partners the importance of collecting and considering diverse customer perspectives throughout the design process
Business-Focused: Demonstrate a mastery of products, processes, customers, competitors and broader industry trends and apply this knowledge to predict shifts in these areas and shape how Design should engage, uncover and solve significant business challenges
Problem-Solving: Revels in the art of the possible, driving cross-functional groups in thinking creatively about potential solutions, illuminating potential pitfalls and fostering shared learnings; builds frameworks for complex decision-making that enable effective debate and accelerate getting to the right solutions
Collaboration: Connect the dots across the organization, proactively bringing together executive partners in ways that drive more coherent experiences, accelerate delivery and elevate the value of design
Communication: Present work to executive leaders and stakeholders, modeling a strategic human-centered approach that integrates design frameworks, data and research insights to make the complex accessible, influence change and drive strategic direction

The ideal candidate has a strong portfolio demonstrating your leadership, process, results and impact.

Basic Qualifications:

At least 10 years of experience in leading product design teams and delivering products to market
At least 3 years managing managers

Preferred Qualifications:

12+ years of experience in leading product design teams and delivering products to market
Experience in a design toolkit that spans product design, service design, design strategy and content design
Experience leading product design teams operating across UX and UI, strategy, content, and research from strategy through delivery to market
Deep experience partnering with product managers, engineers, marketing, and analytics leaders across multiple business lines to shape strategy, performance metrics, roadmaps, and operating models
Deep experience interfacing with executive leadership to solve problems, influence key decisions, and drive results across strategy, design, roadmaps and investments
